description: The chart illustrates the number of tasks across various language families, with the categories listed on the vertical axis and labeled as IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, in that order. The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, ranging from 0 to 80, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with the height corresponding to the number of tasks; the bars are sorted in descending order of height. The tallest bar, representing IE-Romance, has a value of approximately 78, while the shortest bar, representing Basque, has a value of around 3. The other bars have values of approximately 48 for IE-Germanic, 23 for Uralic, 19 for IE-Baltic, 16 for IE-other, 12 for IE-Indic, 9 for Semitic, and 5 for Turkic. The colors used for the bars are light blue for IE-Romance, dark blue for IE-Germanic, green for Uralic, pink for IE-Baltic, red for IE-other, orange for IE-Indic, dark orange for Semitic, light purple for Turkic, and dark purple for Basque.
